comparison_constraints: Use identical frozen target/background inputs and identical geometry/mismatch rules for comparison, report missing-site evaluability separately from matching failures.
Broad-metazoan primers intentionally amplify non-echinoids: background hits reflect scope differences, not by themselves failure of published primers.
The no-inosine HCO2198 and dgHCO2198 versions are legitimate published tested comparators but do not represent performance of the better-known jgHCO2198 combination.
No claim of MiUrchin superiority over the full published-primer literature is supported by this small benchmark.
The 130-bp and 313-bp fragments are not equal-length comparisons; report resolution and actual product-length trade-offs.
No 16S,12S,28S comparator is included without exact sequence verification.
correction_note: Uni-Minibar entry corrected after detection of a discrepancy between Leray 2013 Table 1 and Meusnier 2008 original Methods. The original design source defines F1=TCCACTAATCACAARGATATTGGTAC and R1=GAAAATCATAATGAAGGCATGAGC. Leray Table 1 image itself contains the discrepancy; it is not an OCR artifact.
